summary: AI is moving into both the PC and the storefront: rivals launched AI PCs and AI-driven shopping while memory costs squeeze AI PC supply.

points.headline: Competitors are putting AI into the storefront, not just the product
points.detail: HP launched Experience AI, an agentic web platform that adapts to customer intent; Gap and TikTok added AI discovery and checkout. Benchmark our store's search and discovery against them.

points.headline: AI PC launch wave meets a memory squeeze
points.detail: Dell, HP and Microsoft ($2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra) launched AI PCs while DRAM shifts to servers and memory costs threaten shipments. Expect price pressure; plan pricing and stock messaging.

points.headline: Nvidia RTX Spark opens a premium Windows-on-Arm tier aimed at Macs
points.detail: RTX Spark laptops opened for pre-order on Oct 7. A new high-end category needs clear Arm vs x86 guidance for online buyers.

points.headline: Marketplaces are scaling up for festive and holiday peaks
points.detail: Amazon India sees a 35-40% festive demand spike and added 50% capacity; Walmart rolled out 1-hour pickup nationwide. Check our stock, delivery promises and deal placement on key marketplaces.

points.headline: JD.com nears EU approval to buy MediaMarkt owner Ceconomy
points.detail: A JD-owned Ceconomy (MediaMarkt, Saturn) would be a new owner for a major European electronics channel, with possible changes to terms and data access for PC brands.
